description: First clean-room lobe fits of the render feasibility prototype (tools/parity/render_fits, task phase0.8_render-reference-fits, decisions 050-052) against the admitted Iray references of the fixed render pipeline (decision 046): formulas with their public sources, fitted constants and residuals in 16-bit display codes on held-out pixels. NO LOBE IS REPRODUCED: every residual lies far outside the noise floor of parity/reports/phase0/iray-noise-floor.md, and it may come from the lobes, the environment handling or the geometry. The support is unequal: the display encoding and the environment orientation are tight, the metal lobe close, the dielectric, bump and filter first guesses.

entries.subject: Save Render 16-bit PNG under OCIO Default - sRGB (fixed pipeline)
entries.formula: code = round(65535 encode(binary16(clamp(L, 0, 1)))) per RGB channel, L the linear render, binary16 IEEE 754 half precision (round to nearest even), encode the IEC 61966-2-1 sRGB encoding. Empirical model of the observed codes: it states which codes an Iray render can contain, not how Iray computes them.

public_sources.locator: display/view transform of an OCIO project

entries.notes: 44734063 of 46769247 interior RGB samples of the 66 fixture renders (0.9565) lie on the model's 10871-code lattice; every other sample is within 1 code of it.

entries.subject: Latitude-longitude environment orientation, lookup and intensity
entries.formula: Direction d (Y up) to texel: u = frac(atan2(-d.x, d.z) / (2 pi) + 1/4 + rotation / 360), v = acos(d.y) / pi (row 0 = +Y); bilinear on texel centres; radiance = file value x 2^exposure x s, exposure 0, s fitted once for all goldens. Orientation fitted on the mirror sphere (the eight sign/offset candidates differ by more than 13x in mean |delta|).
entries.notes: Mean signed (prototype - k*S), 16-bit codes: neutral-reflective +190 +- 5; neutral-reflective--ref-match-000 +94 +- 1; neutral-reflective--ref-match-180 +92 +- 1.

entries.subject: Perspective camera of decision 046 and the pixel filter
entries.formula: Pinhole at +Z 60 looking along -Z, +Y up, 40 degrees across the square 1200 x 1200 image; sample positions drawn from the pixel filter (box; one-pixel box = uniform over the pixel square), each pixel the mean of its own samples.
entries.notes: Edge band mean |delta| per golden: neutral-grey-diffuse 459; plane-mid-grey 316; cube-mid-grey 942 (16-bit codes, 256 samples).

entries.subject: Material channels as stored by Painter and read by the shader
entries.formula: BaseColor: sRGB8 code = floor(255 c + 1/2) of the sRGB value c, decoded by IEC 61966-2-1; BaseMetalness and SpecularRoughness: L8 UNORM (truncate to 12 fractional bits, nearest, ties down), read as code / 255.
entries.notes: The tie rule of sRGB 0.5 and 0.9 was chosen on the mirror sphere (code 230 fits better than 229); the L8 rule is Tier 0's (quantisation-profile.json).

entries.subject: open-pbr base at metalness 1 (default shader, decision 042)
entries.formula: f = F_schlick(o.h; F0 = base colour) D_GGX G2 / (4 cos_o cos_i) + F0 (1 - E1(mu_o)) (1 - E1(mu_i)) / (pi (1 - E1_avg)); alpha = roughness^2; G2 height-correlated Smith; E1 the lobe's albedo with F = 1 (tabulated). The multiple-scattering lobe is tinted by F0 (MDL multiscatter_tint).
entries.notes: Mean signed (prototype - k*S), 16-bit codes: neutral-reflective +190 +- 5; metal1-rough010 +30 +- 4; metal1-rough050 +37 +- 6; metal1-rough090 +4 +- 11.

entries.subject: open-pbr base at metalness 0 (specular IOR 1.5 over diffuse)
entries.formula: f = f_s + layer f_d; f_s: GGX as the metal with Fresnel 'schlick' for IOR 1.5, multiple scattering 'tint_f0'; f_d: 'lambert' with the base colour; layering 'albedo_oi_raw' (albedo_oi_raw: (1 - E_s(mu_o)) (1 - E_s(mu_i)), E_s the specular lobe's directional albedo). Metalness mixes metal and dielectric linearly.
entries.notes: Mean signed (prototype - k*S), 16-bit codes: neutral-grey-diffuse -360 +- 11; base-light-grey -201 +- 51; base-saturated +573 +- 33; metal0-rough010 -510 +- 10; metal0-rough050 -55 +- 39; metal0-rough090 -335 +- 17. The low and mid roughness goldens keep a bias well outside the noise floor: the dielectric is not reproduced (an open lobe question for phase3.5).

entries.subject: Normal-map and height (bump) perturbation
entries.formula: Tangent-space normal n_t = 2c - 1 (bitmap sampled bilinearly in UV) in the frame (T, B, N): T from the UV derivatives averaged per vertex and orthogonalised, B = N x T; height h = 2t - 1 bumped as n_t = normalize(-k dh/du, -k dh/dv, 1) with one-texel backward differences of the 256-px bitmap; where the perturbed normal faces away from the viewer the interpolated normal is kept.
entries.notes: Mean signed (prototype - k*S), 16-bit codes: normal-ridges -529 +- 44; height-stripes -148 +- 41.

entries.subject: Emission colour and opacity under the default shader
entries.formula: Ignored: emission luminance 0, alpha test and alpha blending off (decision 042); the goldens render as metal0-rough050.
entries.notes: Mean signed (prototype - k*S), 16-bit codes: emission -47 +- 28; opacity-stripes -47 +- 28; metal0-rough050 -55 +- 39.

entries.subject: Held-out geometry (plane, cube) and the ref_match environment
entries.formula: The fitted model without change on the flat-faced meshes and under the ref_match HDRI at rotations 0 and 180.
entries.notes: Mean signed (prototype - k*S), 16-bit codes: plane-mid-grey -513 +- 4; cube-mid-grey -60 +- 18; neutral-grey-diffuse--ref-match-000 -346 +- 6; neutral-grey-diffuse--ref-match-180 +220 +- 29; cube-saturated--ref-match-000 +528 +- 8; cube-saturated--ref-match-180 +928 +- 60.

entries.subject: Light transport of the prototype under the fixed pipeline
entries.formula: Unidirectional path tracing, NEE toward the environment and a BSDF sample per vertex combined by the power heuristic, Russian roulette after depth 3, at most 8 vertices, RGB in float64, Owen-scrambled Sobol under a fixed seed; a direction below the facet is absorbed. On one convex mesh under an infinite environment no light-carrying path has a second vertex.
